# [EPIC] AI-Powered Frontend Integration

## Epic
ai-service (#36, #93) already implements catalog-grounded recommendations, a
persisted-conversation chat assistant, semantic taste search, and offline
voice transcription — but only speech-to-text has any frontend surface
today (`VoiceControl.jsx`, #68). This epic closes that gap and adds one
genuinely new capability: natural-language complex movie search (typed or
dictated) that resolves queries like "movies Tom Hanks directed between
2000 and 2010 that also starred Meg Ryan" into real filtered results, with
the search bar visibly highlighting the words doing the work (and/or,
negation, entities) so the user can see the query is being understood, not
just guessed at. Voice control also gets a correctness pass: it currently
runs on a small English-only Vosk model matched by rigid regex, which
misreads non-native/regional accents — this epic makes it bilingual
(English/German) and robust to accented and dialectal speech in both.

## Business Value
Turns ai-service from a backend capability that exists in isolation into a
demonstrable, full-stack AI feature — the actual product differentiator of
this platform. Also fixes a real, reported defect: voice control fails for
non-native English speakers today.

## Product Goal alignment
Serves the [Product Goal](../docs/process/PRODUCT_GOAL.md)'s "production-grade
backend/frontend... practice, real enough to run and demo" bar — an AI
service with no frontend integration doesn't demonstrate anything end to
end. Stays inside the $0 budget (ADR-004): Ollama and Vosk only, no paid
provider, no new cloud spend.

## Notes
Prioritization: Stories C1 (complex NL search), C2 (query highlighting), and
D (bilingual/accent-robust voice) are pulled into Sprint 8 — they're what
this epic was actually requested for. Stories A (recommendations surface)
and B (chat assistant surface) stay in the Product Backlog, unscheduled,
for the next Sprint — smaller, lower-urgency surface work on endpoints that
already fully exist.

#198 closed. #199 closed (#210's dictation-highlighting fix satisfied its
AC5). #196 closed (frontend recommendations surface, Tasks #219-#222).
#197/#200 remain open — epic stays open (#200 is blocked on #215 needing
real accented/dialectal audio samples and #229 needing real Vosk archive
SHA256s, both requiring things this autonomous environment doesn't have: a
human/microphone and network egress to alphacephei.com).
